latest_update.author: Ads Team
latest_update.text: @Sohib Boundaoui ﻿ ﻿ ﻿﻿﻿ After reviewing the account over the last two weeks I want to suggest pausing a few ads that are not performing. “Sue Your Friend” in the Calls campaign spent $29 and got zero calls. Arabic Ad 3 in the Awareness campaign spent $137 and only got 1 lead, while Arabic Ad 1 in the same campaign got 2 leads for $35 so the budget is better off going there. “Sue Your Friend Copy” in English Only is barely getting any delivery from Meta. And in retargeting, Video-2, Video-4 and Video-5 all spent under $8 each with zero leads because Meta is already pushing everything to Video-9 which is our best performer. Pausing these will stop the budget from leaking into ads that are not converting and let the ones actually working get more of it.
